claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

Hidden Sp(Nc), Nc even and fundamental dimension Nc, with2Nf Weyl fundamentals. Therefore canonical Crank=Nc/2, fundamental[1,0,...]. Minimal displayed Sp2=SU2,Nf2 gives four independent Weyl doublets, not five elementary pions. Pions are composite IR coordinates.
Other families: SU(Nc) with Nf Dirac fundamentals; O(Nc) with Nf fermions in vector. Sp2,Nf2; Sp8,Nf2 and SU3,Nf3 numerical dark-sector examples appear. Flavour/global groups are not gauge groups.

Paper supplies explicit dark confining sectors but defers viable mediation between visible and hidden sectors to a forthcoming work. Do not invent connector charges or claim a complete SM-coupled microscopic inventory from pion scattering EFT.
